→ You hold a loser because you don’t want a red day

→ 16 small wins, then 4 big losses wipe them out

title: Ten losses in a row will happen to you at some point.
cleaned_caption:
Ten losses in a row will happen to you at some point.

Every strategy goes through it, even the good ones.

At 2% risk per trade, that streak takes $50,000 down to $40,854, and you need a 22% gain to get back.

At 20% risk, the same streak leaves you with $5,369, and getting back to $50,000 takes an 831% gain.

Size your trades for your worst streak instead of your best day.
